title: Ethiopian Sambusa Duck Fritters
description: A twist on traditional Ethiopian sambusa, these crispy fritters are filled with duck and spices. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Quick Ethiopian Injera Bread
ingredients.notes: Toasted in a pan until crispy

ingredients.name: Sambusa spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern or African markets

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, combine the duck, crumbled injera, sambusa spice blend, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Add the breadcrumbs to the bowl and mix until the mixture is well combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter and 1/2 inch (1.3 cm) thick.
Carefully place the patties in the hot oil and fry until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the sambusa duck fritters hot and enjoy!
